final: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS daily_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), cross_rating AS (SELECT AVG(daily_price) AS avg_daily_price FROM rating_averages) SELECT AVG(r.avg_replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(r.daily_price) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(r.daily_price - c.avg_daily_price) AS avg_excess_daily_price FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN cross_rating AS c WHERE r.daily_price > c.avg_daily_price
